map.title: Fishing Map
map.chartsNotReadyTitle: Charts are not set up yet
map.chartsNotReadyBody: Garmin has not issued the chart keys yet, so nothing will change on the map for now. Your choices are saved and will be used as soon as charts can draw.
map.contourDensityHint: More lines means more detail, and a busier chart.
map.allContoursHint: Off shows only the lines around the depth you picked below.
map.easyViewHint: Bigger text and symbols, and a simpler chart. Easier to read on a wet phone.
map.seabedHint: Shades the bottom by what it is made of — mud, sand or rock.
map.shallowLimitHint: Anything shallower than this is shaded as a hazard.
map.depthContoursHint: The depth the highlighted contour lines are drawn from.
map.depthAreasHint: The depth the shaded bands are drawn from.
map.fishingModeHint: Recolours the chart to pick out the depth band you set below.
map.fishingShallowHint: The shallow end of the depth band you want picked out.
map.fishingDeepHint: The deep end of the depth band you want picked out.
map.poolLevelHint: For lakes and reservoirs only. Leave at 0 for saltwater.
map.settingsFootnote: These settings come from Garmin's chart library. None of them has been seen on a real chart yet, because no chart has drawn.
map.onlyValue: Fixed — only one value is allowed
map.sizeOnceSetUp: Size shown once charts are set up
map.downloadDoneBody: This area is now on your phone and will work with no signal.
map.cannotDownloadBody: Garmin will not download this area. It may be outside the area your subscription covers.
map.deleteAllBody: This removes every chart you have downloaded, for every area. Garmin does not allow deleting one area at a time. You can download them again later.
map.deleteFailedBody: The charts could not be deleted. Try again.
map.deleteNotSetUpBody: There is nothing to delete — charts are not set up on this phone yet.
